subject: ENVIRONMENT
bill.title: Requires DEP to conduct study of short and long term effects of water use by large-scale data centers.

action.description: Referred to Senate Budget and Appropriations Committee

posted_text:
🏢 NJ S4400 — NJ Wants to Know: How Data Centers Are Using Your Water

New Jersey is asking the DEP to investigate the impact of large-scale data centers on the state’s water resources. This bill directs the Department of Environmental Protection to study how these facilities – which use massive amounts of water for cooling – affect drinking water, wastewater systems, and the environment. ...
